sentences.text: Gain sets overall sensitivity: too low and you miss weak targets, too high and the screen fills with speckle.
Sea clutter control reduces echoes from waves close to the boat.
Rain clutter control breaks up the solid returns from rain.
The danger is turning these controls up so far that real targets, like a small boat or a buoy, disappear.
Displays can be head-up, with the heading line straight up, or north-up and course-up, which stabilize the picture using a heading sensor and make plotting easier.
